objective: Complete source-specific TED product admission and connect the authenticated tenant-scoped ResearchRun loop to governed procurement evidence, claims and dossiers in InvestigationContext.
outcome: A verified private-pilot organisation can create a persistent live TED ResearchRun from Navigator, observe bounded progress, receive a source-linked procurement dossier and admitted claim state in InvestigationContext, and replay or roll back the workflow without fixture authority, tenant leakage, broad live-source activation or model-written canonical truth.

skills.activation_reason: Resolve the exact TED rights, attribution, retention, display and revocation boundary before product use.
Promote only the admitted TED profiles into bounded persistent execution.
Keep Evidence Objects, Candidate Claims and canonical admission distinct.
Wire identity, tenant, ResearchRun persistence, worker execution and InvestigationContext resources.
Verify server-side tenancy, permissions, credentials, queues and export boundaries.
Preserve personal-data minimisation and tenant isolation across source and document processing.
Prove E2E progress, retry, idempotency, replay, rollback and source kill-switch behaviour.
Prevent technical evidence from being represented as public or commercial validation.

allowed_scope: Authenticated identity and server-side tenant resolution
Polling progress with resumable durable state
Worker processing of the admitted bounded TED Search profile
Source-specific live TED activation inside a private pilot
Deterministic admission and bounded human review
Dossier and claim return to InvestigationContext
Source, live-source, tenant and workflow kill switches
prohibited_scope: Supplier suitability, win probability, margin or legal conclusions
Public general availability before F9 and F12 acceptance

acceptance_evidence.description: Exact TED commercial-use, storage, transformation, display, export, attribution, personal-data and revocation dimensions are accepted for the promoted profile.

Authenticated tenant-scoped E2E and adversarial tests prove ResearchRun creation, progress, completion, dossier return, forged and expired identity rejection, tenant injection rejection, isolation, idempotency and independent kill switches.

The exact-head persistent circuit links the bounded TED source projection to Evidence Objects, Candidate Claims, deterministic canonical Claims and an attributed dossier; cross-tenant reads are blocked and model calls equal zero.

Identity, server-side tenant resolution, forced RLS, role separation, queue, source, privacy, export, model-authority and kill-switch boundaries pass an independent automated review for the private-pilot deployment boundary.
Ten reproducible persistent runs measure latency, bounded-field completeness, external variable cost, failure rate, zero model calls and zero rollback residue against explicit thresholds.

Qualified B2G buyer comprehension, willingness to pay, paid evidence and commercial packaging are not runtime-admission evidence. They remain mandatory in AX-F9-T15 and are explicitly not claimed here.

logs: workflow, live-source and source kill-switch state

rollback.strategy: Disable the TED workflow, its independent live-source flag or the registered source; return the UI to a read-only evidence state while preserving append-only audit and canonical history.
rollback.kill_switch: AXIGNAL_TED_PROCUREMENT_ENABLED=false, AXIGNAL_TED_LIVE_SOURCES_ENABLED=false and the per-source database kill switch independently stop new execution without deleting prior evidence.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The task completes the selected discovery wedge through a real authenticated professional workflow.
Every admitted procurement field remains linked to official evidence and versioned admission.
The same InvestigationContext can drive Navigator, Globe, Graph, Timeline and dossier surfaces.
User intent cannot create procurement truth or bypass source admission.
Original source values remain recoverable and transformations are attributed.
Persistent evidence, lifecycle and dossier state create defence beyond generic summarisation.
The workflow prepares pursue, monitor or decline research without executing or recommending a bid.
Rights, privacy, tenancy, security and authority gates are explicit acceptance evidence.
Independent workflow, live-source and source kill switches plus zero-residue rollback are tested.
F8 runtime admission is closed without bypassing the separate F9 commercial validation gate.
